verdict.rationale: LocalAI is described as "one binary" with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. It also offers PRELOAD_MODELS / --preload-models to load models ahead of requests, which may reduce the wait before first inference. Nothing in the pack measures or claims fast cold-start times, and the binary's lightweightness is not substantiated. Missing for 10: documented or benchmarked cold-start latency, evidence the runtime is lightweight, independent or hands-on corroboration of startup speed.
